operations.description: Un-blocklisting `rm` only regresses in unsafe mode; safe mode still rejects it as unallowlisted. Assert the unsafe-mode sweep ran, not that both modes regress.

edits.replace:
# Unsafe mode is where this module's bypasses were actually exploitable, and it is the
        # only mode a removed blocklist entry regresses in: safe mode still rejects `rm` as
        # unallowlisted. Asserting False is present keeps a refactor that stops sweeping
        # safe_mode=False from leaving this green.
        assert False in {item["safe_mode"] for item in report["regressions"]}

operations.description: `IFS=$'\n' ls` trips `environment override: IFS`, not `IFS whitespace-evasion` (pattern is \$\{?IFS, needing $IFS/${IFS}). Add a probe that reaches the evasion rule; keep the old one, which is the only probe for the env-override label.
